what_separates_them_in_principle: A GSK3-specific manipulation that reproduces the lithium effect, and a lithium effect that survives loss of GSK3
done_so_far (evidence ids): Lithium lowers the PTZ score in wild type and heterozygote as in the null (R02); lithium blocks one stimulant response and not another (E04); lithium inhibits other kinases at slightly lower potency (E30); Mg2+ competition and a second target (IT15, carried)
open: No source tests lithium in a GSK3-deleted or knock-down background; no Wwox-null system with a second GSK3 inhibitor; lithium effect on the PI4KIIalpha branch untested
status: Untested in WWOX; precedent for target-dependence control exists in another system (E24)
smallest_test: Lithium and a dual or isoform-selective inhibitor at matched verified target engagement; lithium repeated after GSK3A and GSK3B knock-down (X2, X4)

what_separates_them_in_principle: Isoform-selective probes with an inactive enantiomer, isoform knock-down, a readout per isoform (Tyr279 vs Tyr216)
done_so_far (evidence ids): Alpha, not beta, drives hippocampal LTD (E09, abstract); beta, not alpha, drives a stimulant response in knock-in mice (E03); biochemical 8- to 14-fold probes shrink to 4- to 6-fold in cells and lose selectivity at higher concentration (E20, E21, E23); CT99021 is dual (E22, E28); the PI4KIIalpha paper tested no isoform (E16)
open: Which isoform carries the PI4KIIalpha-NMDAR branch; any isoform datum in a WWOX system or in cortical neurons for the burst phenotype
status: Open; the title attribution to beta is not supported by an isoform test
smallest_test: BRD0705, BRD3731, BRD5648 pair plus isoform knock-down in the same neurons (X2, X4) [Audit: E28 cannot show duality (the Bain panel has no GSK3 alpha); duality rests on E22 and on Wagner calling CHIR99021 pan-GSK3.]

what_separates_them_in_principle: Substrate-level readouts (PI4KIIalpha branch: isolated NMDAR current; tau; beta-catenin; glycogen synthase) read beside the kinase readout
done_so_far (evidence ids): PI4KIIalpha branch lowers synaptic NMDAR current by half with AMPA and LTD spared (E10, E11, E17, E18); tau anchors alpha in LTD (E09); beta-catenin handled by the destruction complex and Wnt (E06); eIF2B epsilon is a separate chain (gsk3_eif2b)
open: No ATP-site compound is substrate-selective; substrate-competitive and Axin-docking classes not found as named usable probes (IT15); no phospho-PI4KIIalpha readout in any WWOX system
status: Open; one genetic branch tool exists, no pharmacological branch tool
smallest_test: PI4K2A knock-down with resistant wild type and S9/51A (X3); phospho-substrate panel (X1)

what_separates_them_in_principle: Ser9/Ser21 phosphorylation vs beta-catenin phosphorylation after Wnt
done_so_far (evidence ids): Wnt3a acted normally in S21A/S9A knock-in ES cells and did not raise pooled Ser9/Ser21 phosphorylation (E06); a drug still acts in S21A/S9A tissue (E05)
open: A Ser9 change in the Wwox-null blot (R01) does not say whether the Wnt/beta-catenin arm is touched; no beta-catenin readout in any WWOX neural system under a GSK3 inhibitor
status: Established outside WWOX and outside neurons; open inside
smallest_test: beta-catenin phospho and total, and reporter, read in the same cells as the burst endpoint (X1, X3)

what_separates_them_in_principle: Acute provoked score vs threshold vs spontaneous seizures vs maturation, in separate exposures
done_so_far (evidence ids): Lithium lowered a PTZ score after one fixed dose in preweaning mice, in all genotypes (R02); GSK3 sign on oligodendrocyte differentiation divided (R05, R06); knock-in mice without Ser9 control develop normally in the metabolic assessment, compensation not excluded (E07)
open: No threshold, spontaneous-seizure or maturation data for any GSK3 manipulation in a WWOX system; prolonged exposure safety unknown
status: Open; do not assume a post-development window
smallest_test: Acute current experiments first; prolonged exposure as a separate arm with viability and maturation read-outs (X3 acute vs X5 prolonged)

what_separates_them_in_principle: A matched-current NMDAR reduction that does as well; wild-type control at the same effect; viability and AMPA transmission
done_so_far (evidence ids): CT99021 lowers NMDAR current in control neurons (E12), so any burst reduction by GSK3 inhibition may be plain current reduction; AMPA unchanged by PI4KIIalpha knock-down (E10)
open: Whether a GSK3-route reduction differs from d-APV at matched current; basal-transmission cost in KO neurons; floor effects of the occlusion (E13)
smallest_test: d-APV matched-current arm shared with the NMDA package X2 (X2 here)
